kabossImage.title: KABOSS IMAGE
kabossImage.short: A multi-service business center website for KABOSS Inc in Nyamasheke, Rwanda — live and working.
kabossImage.overview: KABOSS IMAGE is the website for KABOSS Inc, a multi-service business center in Nyamasheke, Rwanda. The site presents the company's services — printing, graphic design, photography, sound system and digital services, including Irembo assistance — with a gallery, testimonials and full contact details.
kabossImage.problem: A small multi-service business needed a clear online presence: one place where clients can see every service, understand what is offered, and find contact details quickly — because many customers meet a business online first.
kabossImage.role: I developed the site for the client with a mix of original work and existing resources. The published site credits "Developed by HIRWA Aime Jospin" in its footer.
built: A hero section introducing KABOSS Inc as a multi-service business center, with links to the services and contact sections
Six service sections — Printing, Graphic Design, Photography, Sound System, Digital Services and Irembo Assistance — each listing its sub-services
A "Why Choose KABOSS" section covering professional quality, timely delivery, affordable pricing and customer focus
A testimonials section with three client quotes
A gallery section showcasing completed work
A call-to-action section, plus a footer with quick links, the service list, contact details, opening hours and a WhatsApp chat widget
kabossImage.learned: Keeping a live client site clear, fast and easy to update — and describing each service in a way that answers the client's questions before they ask.

umudugudu.title: Umudugudu Management System
umudugudu.short: A functional prototype for managing citizen information at the village (umudugudu) level.
umudugudu.overview: The Umudugudu Management System is a functional prototype of a tool for managing citizen information at the level of the umudugudu — the smallest local administrative unit, a village, in Rwanda.
umudugudu.problem: Local administrators often track citizen information on paper or in scattered files. A simple digital system could help keep records consistent, complete and easier to look up.
umudugudu.role: I built this prototype in PHP and HTML.
built: A working prototype of the citizen-information management system, built with PHP and HTML
The owner describes it as having many features — the full feature list is still being documented (see docs/CONTENT-TODO.md)
umudugudu.learned: Designing a data-entry tool around a real administrative workflow — and the privacy care that citizen information demands.
